series_summary: Rentaro Aijo encounters his destined third soulmate, the painfully shy and mute bookworm Shizuka Yoshimoto, in the school library. To bridge the silence that has isolated her from the world, Rentaro immerses himself in her favorite romance novel, passionately reenacting its climax to win her trust, and manually transcribes the entire book into a digital text-to-speech app so her beloved characters can give voice to her deepest thoughts. Confronting his existing girlfriends Hakari and Karane on the school rooftop, Rentaro and Shizuka bravely face their scrutiny, ultimately winning their hearts and uniting all three soulmates in a heartwarming bond of mutual devotion.

title: Three Hearts Bound Against All Odds — Part 5

segments.voiceover_text: Up on the windy school rooftop, Hakari and Karane fiercely corner Rentaro, demanding to know where his attention has wandered all afternoon.
Bracing for furious accusations, Rentaro drops toward his knees, shielding the tiny, trembling Shizuka safely behind his back.
Gathering her courage, Shizuka presses her smartphone screen, letting the digital voice softly ask if they could please become friends.
Disarmed by her helpless innocence, both girls shriek with adoration, aggressively smothering Shizuka in an affectionate embrace of pure love.
With three soulmates united under the open sky, Rentaro passionately vows to protect every single one of their radiant smiles for eternity.
